gear_sun_motor.note: NEMA17 5 mm shaft (use grub screw M3 on a flat); 1 per axis

gear_planet.note: 3 per stage x 2 stages x 2 axes

rotor_housing.note: two internal herringbone rings, one piece; 6 x M3 through-bolts

carrier1_plate_A.note: planet axles pressed (4 mm rod, 3 per plate)

carrier1_plate_B_sun2.note: plate with integrated 2nd-stage sun (print upright, tune clearance)

carrier2_plate_A.note: rides on sun2 hub, axles pressed

output_flange.note: universal interface: 4xM4 on 40 mm PCD + 20 mm spigot

rotor_endcap.note: 6806 bearing seat; 6 x M3 same circle as the housing

motor_plate.note: NEMA17 31 mm square pattern, 6xM3 to the housing

tripod_adapter_1-4.note: M4 flange side + 1/4"-20 screw (hex nut M6.35 trap underneath); 3/8" tripods: use stock reducer bush

stub_spigot_20.note: OPTIONAL printed stub; cheaper: 20 mm aluminium/CF tube 1 mm wall (BOM)

boom_clamp_16_lower.note: for 16 mm boom; bolts 2xM4 (nut traps omitted -> use nylock + washer)

boom_clamp_20_lower.note: for 20 mm boom; bolts 2xM4 (nut traps omitted -> use nylock + washer)

boom_clamp_25_lower.note: for 25 mm boom; bolts 2xM4 (nut traps omitted -> use nylock + washer)

cross_hub_16.note: 1 per element station (3 VHF + 4 UHF); 4 hinge lugs for M3 pivots

hinge_arm.note: swing arm: 3.1 mm bore for the 3 mm aluminium rod (epoxy/M2 grub); folds along the boom

radio_cradle_RT3S.note: open-top tray, 4xM4 on 40 mm PCD (same as every interface) + Velcro strap through the side windows; internal size is a PARAMETER

control_box.note: ESP32 + 2xTMC2209 + buck/PD + diplexer bay (72x40 PCB, BNC/SMA bulkheads on +X face)

coupon_gear_clearance.note: print this first: check it slides on the 4 mm pin and meshes with a printed sun tooth coupon
